vacation_file_details = [apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=file_system_access_token, file_path=path) for path in vacation_files]
print([{'path': item['path'], 'created_at': item['created_at']} for item in vacation_file_details])

destination_directories = {spot: apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=file_system_access_token, directory_path=f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}', recursive=True, allow_if_exists=True) for spot in ['Rome', 'Santorini', 'Berlin']}
print(destination_directories)

passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
password_by_app = {item['account_name']: item['password'] for item in passwords}
simple_note_login = apis.simple_note.login(username='gra-martinez@gmail.com', password=password_by_app['simple_note'])
venmo_login = apis.venmo.login(username='gra-martinez@gmail.com', password=password_by_app['venmo'])
simple_note_token = simple_note_login['access_token']
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']
print({'simple_note_login': simple_note_login, 'venmo_login': venmo_login})

dinner_notes = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='dinner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    dinner_notes.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print(dinner_notes)

 "content": "# Weekly Workout Plan

exercises:

- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

exercises:

- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

duration_mins: 130

exercises:

library_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.search_songs(page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, min_duration=65 * 60)
    if not page:
        break
